audience: home service businesses who schedule jobs and customers in Zenbooker

useCases.title: See scheduled jobs and who is assigned
useCases.text: The AI lists jobs in a start-time window, filtered by status, territory or team member. It opens one for the address, services, providers and notes.

useCases.title: Find a customer and their jobs
useCases.text: The AI searches customers by name, email or phone, or by distance from a place, and opens one for addresses, notes, job ids and recurring bookings.

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices and failed payments
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices by status such as unpaid or partial_paid, with amount due, and payment transactions by status such as failed.

useCases.title: Find open time slots for a service area
useCases.text: The AI checks if a location is in a service area, then gets available time slots of a territory by day for a service duration in minutes.

useCases.title: Review incoming booking and quote requests
useCases.text: The AI lists service requests with status, customer, requested dates, services and pricing. You see what needs an answer.

useCases.title: Add a customer or a note on a job
useCases.text: The AI creates a customer record, after a search to avoid duplicates, or adds an internal note to a job. Notes cannot be deleted through this server.
